observations: Three photos show a pair of car headlamps lying on a concrete floor.
The headlamps have a dark, smoked tint on the lens surface.
The design includes angular housing with visible internal reflectors and bulb housings.
The left headlamp (from viewer's perspective) has a red turn signal section on the outer edge.
The right headlamp has a similar red section on its outer edge.
The headlamps appear to be for a modern sedan, possibly a luxury model.
No visible brand or model markings are readable on the headlamps in any photo.
The seller claims they are for a Benz E350 2014-2015, but no such text is visible in the photos.
The headlamps are not mounted on a vehicle; they are standalone units.
There is a red plastic stool in the background of all photos.

claims.claim: Neat headlamp Benz e350 2014 2015 charger type
claims.evidence: No brand or model markings are visible in any photo. The design does not clearly match known Benz E350 2014-2015 headlamps, which typically have a more distinct bi-xenon or LED signature. The term 'charger type' is unclear and not visible.

claims.claim: You can remove the smoked tinted on the surface by...
claims.evidence: The photos show the smoked tint, but no proof of removability is provided. The method or result of removal is not shown.

risks.risk: The headlamps are not for a Benz E350 2014-2015 as claimed.
risks.proof: A clear photo showing the model badge or VIN tag from the car they were removed from, or a close-up of the headlamp housing with a visible part number matching Benz E350 2014-2015.
risks.if_unproven: priced as generic used headlamps, not premium Benz parts

risks.risk: The headlamps are damaged or non-functional (e.g., cracked lens, broken bulbs, wiring issues).
risks.proof: A close-up of the internal components showing intact bulbs, reflectors, and wiring harnesses, and a video of them turning on.

risks.risk: The smoked tint is permanent or cannot be removed as claimed.
risks.proof: A photo or video showing the headlamp after tint removal, revealing the original clear lens.
risks.if_unproven: priced as having permanent tint, which may reduce value

proof_requests: A close-up photo of the headlamp housing showing any part numbers or model identifiers.
A photo of the car they were removed from, or the VIN tag.
A video showing the headlamps turning on and off.
A photo or video showing the headlamp after the smoked tint has been removed.
response.reason: The seller claims the headlamps are for a Benz E350 2014-2015, but no identifying marks are visible in the photos. Without proof of model compatibility, functionality, or removability of the tint, the item cannot be priced accurately. The risks of misrepresentation and non-functionality are high.
